import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import ledger as L
import observe_output as O
import replay_seeded_defects as R
T, N = chr(9), chr(10)
want = {'A': ('53fb0f5817aa94c8845e9811d29123afdff85dbb', 'scripts/verification_record.py', 'T-043'), 'B': ('0e3cebacc3123496f524202bd0cf14783012e69e', 'scripts/execution_runner.py', 'T-042'), 'C': ('eb7e8c7e61274c1eab37bff3571e485d9854e17d', 'scripts/ledger.py', 'T-044')}
assert {c['id']: (c['commit'], c['file'], c['task']) for c in R.CASES} == want
FIX = 'tests/fixtures/replay-seeded-defects/2a-seeded-calibration.jsonl'
assert R.REQUIRED_2A == FIX, R.REQUIRED_2A
orig = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', '06481fd:docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/routing-data.jsonl'], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob %d' % len(orig) + bytes(1) + orig).hexdigest() == '745971d1075b267725f94f8365e258caa2751058', 'git show 06481fd did not return the 2A blob'
olines = orig.decode('utf-8').split(N)
picked = [n for n, x in enumerate(olines, 1) if '"type":"seeded-calibration"' in x]
assert picked == [85, 86, 87, 92, 93, 94], picked
fix = Path(FIX).read_bytes()
assert fix == (N.join(olines[n - 1] for n in picked) + N).encode('utf-8'), 'the fixture is not lines 85-87 and 92-94 of the 06481fd file'
assert not [x for x in fix.decode('utf-8').splitlines() if L.EMAIL.search(x) or L.ABSOLUTE_PATH.search(x) or any(p.search(x) for p in L.SECRET_PATTERNS)], 'the fixture trips a ledger privacy pattern'
assert R.required(FIX) == {'argon': ['A', 'B', 'C'], 'grok': ['A', 'B', 'C']}
for name in ('scripts/replay_seeded_defects.py', 'tests/test-replay-seeded-defects.py'):
    assert 'routing-data.jsonl' not in Path(name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'), name + ' reads live routing data'
A = next(c for c in R.CASES if c['id'] == 'A')
def git(d, *a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(d), *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    for bad in ({'reviewer': 'someone-else', 'case': 'A', 'task': 'T-043', 'commit': '53fb0f5'}, {'reviewer': 'grok-4.7-high', 'case': 'A', 'task': 'T-043', 'commit': '0e3ceba'}, {'reviewer': 'grok-4.7-high', 'case': 'D', 'task': 'T-043', 'commit': '53fb0f5'}):
        rows = Path(tmp, 'rows.jsonl')
        rows.write_text(json.dumps(dict(bad, type='seeded-calibration', caught=True)) + N)
        try:
            R.required(rows)
        except R.ReplayError:
            continue
        raise SystemExit('accepted %r' % (bad,))
    for c in R.CASES:
        d = Path(tmp, c['id'])
        assert R.plant(Path.cwd(), c, d) == d
        assert git(d, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD~1') == git(d, 'rev-parse', c['commit'] + '~1'), c['id']
        assert git(d, 'diff', '--numstat', c['commit'], 'HEAD') == '1' + T + '1' + T + c['file'] + N, c['id']
        assert git(d, 'log', '-1', '--format=%s%n%an%n%ae', 'HEAD') == git(d, 'log', '-1', '--format=%s%n%an%n%ae', c['commit']), c['id']
        assert git(d, 'remote') == '' and git(d, 'status', '--porcelain') == '', c['id']
        text = (d / c['file']).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        assert c['old'] not in text and c['new'] in text, c['id']
    try:
        R.plant(Path.cwd(), dict(A, old='no such text anywhere'), Path(tmp, 'X'))
    except R.ReplayError:
        pass
    else:
        raise SystemExit('missing old text accepted')
def verdict(v, findings):
    return json.dumps({'run_ids': [], 'commits': [{'commit': 'HEAD', 'verdict': v, 'evidence': ['git show HEAD']}], 'findings': findings, 'verdict': v})
def raw(provider, body):
    event = {'claude': {'type': 'result', 'result': body}, 'agent': {'type': 'result', 'result': body}, 'agy': {'event': 'result', 'result': {'response': body}}, 'codex': {'type': 'item.completed', 'item': {'type': 'agent_message', 'text': body}}}[provider]
    return (json.dumps({'type': 'system'}) + N + json.dumps(event) + N).encode()
hit = {'id': 'F1', 'severity': 'blocking', 'text': 'scripts/verification_record.py:33 the marker pattern lacks re.M, so SKIP on line 2 passes'}
for p in ('claude', 'agent', 'agy', 'codex'):
    assert O.final_answer(p, raw(p, 'x')) == 'x', p
    assert R.caught(p, raw(p, verdict('FAIL', [hit])), A), p
for body in (verdict('PASS', [hit]), verdict('FAIL', [dict(hit, severity='non-blocking')]), verdict('FAIL', [dict(hit, text='scripts/ledger.py:40 re.M is missing')]), verdict('FAIL', [dict(hit, text='scripts/verification_record.py:33 looks wrong')]), json.dumps({'verdict': 'FAIL'}), 'no verdict'):
    assert not R.caught('claude', raw('claude', body), A), body
assert not R.caught('claude', verdict('FAIL', [hit]).encode(), A)
assert O.final_answer('claude', b'not json') is None and O.final_answer('gpt', raw('claude', 'x')) is None
print('ok')
